caption:
You keep adding, and it's never enough. But what if the one thing you needed was already finished before you added anything at all? (Galatians 6:11 devotional)

You keep stacking a little more effort, a little more merit, as if the cross needs your signature too. But if your works could finish salvation, Christ had no reason to die — the moment merit is added, grace stops being grace and the good news collapses. Paul's oversized handwriting is one giant underline beneath "It is finished"; in Christ there is literally nothing left for you to add.
